spans.s:
mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Cold, frigid.
n. (-मं)
1 Frost, snow.
2

Cold.
3

Sandal.
4

Fresh butter.
5

Tin.
6

A pearl.
7 A lotus.
m. (-मः)
1 The Sandal tree.
2 The moon.
3

Camphor.
4

The Himālaya mountain.
f. (-मा)
1 Small cardamoms.
2 Reṇukā, a perfume.
3 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus.)
E.
हन to hurt, मक् Uṇādi aff., and हि substituted for the root.

m. (-तुः)
The cold season.
E.
हिम, and ऋतु season.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Frigorific, cold.
m. (-रः)
1 The moon.
2 Camphor.
E.
हिम cold, and कर who makes, or a ray.

m. (-टः)
Winter.
E.
हिम frost or cold, and कूट a quantity.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Produced by cold, in the Himālaya, &c.
m. (-जः)
1 The mountain Maināka.
f. (-जा)
1 PĀRVATĪ.
2 Zedoary.
E.
हिम the Himāla personified, and ज born.

f. (-टिः)
Mist, dew, fog.
E.
हिम cold, ज्झट to be entangled, इ aff.

n. (-नं)
Winter, wintry weather, frost and snow.
E.
हिम cold, and दुर्द्दिन bad weather.

m. (-तिः)
The moon.
E.
हिम cold, cooling, and द्युति radiance.

m. (-स्थः)
The Himālaya mountains.
E.
हिम cold, and प्रस्थ abode.

f. (-का)
Camphor.
E.
हिम cold, and बालुका sand.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Cold, freezing, chilly, frosty.
m. (-वान्)
The Himālaya range.
E.
हिम cold, and मतुप् aff.

m. (-तः)
1 The mountain Maināka.
f. (-ता)
1 The

Ganges.
2

PĀRVATĪ.
E.
हिमवत् the Himālaya, and सुत son, or सुता daughter.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Very cold, frosty, freezing.
E.
हिम, and शीतल cold.

f. (-जा)
The goddess DURGĀ or PĀRVATĪ.
E.
हिमशैल the snowy mountains, and जा daughter.

m. (-थः)
The moon.
E.
हिम, and श्रथि to shed, अच् aff.

f. (-तिः)
Ice and snow.
E.
हिम cold, संहति assemblage.

m. (-त्)
Fire.
E.
हिम, हान loss, कृत् what makes.

m. (-कः)
The marshy date tree.
E.
हिम cold or winter, and हासक smiling.

m. (-शुः)
1 The moon.
2 Camphor.
E.
हिम cold, अंशु a ray.

n. (-ख्या)
Silver.
E.
हिमांशु the moon, अभिख्या appellation.

m. (-मः)
The cold season, winter.
E.
हिम cold or frost, and आगम arrival.

m. (-द्रिः)
The snowy range of mountains, skirting the north of India, the Imaus or Emodus.
E.
हिम cold, and अद्रि a mountain.

f. (-नी)
Ice and snow.
E.
हिम cold, ङीष् aff., and आनुक augment.

m. (-लः)
A frosty or cold wind.
E.
हिम, and अनिल wind.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
Like frost and snow.
E.
हिम, and आभ resembling.

Fire.
2

The sun.
E.
हिम cold, अराति the enemy; also similar compounds, as, &c.

mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं)
Chilly, cold, suffering from cold.
E.
हिम, and आर्त्त pained.

m. (-यः)
The Himāla or Himālaya range of mountains, which bounds India on the north, and separates it from Tartary; the Imaus and Emodus of the ancients, giving rise to the Ganges, and Indus, and many other considerable rivers, and containing the highest elevations in the world: in mythology, the mountain is personified as the husband of MENAKĀ, and the father of GAṄGĀ or the Ganges, and DURGĀ or UMĀ in her descent as PĀRVATĪ, the mountain nymph, to captivate ŚIVA, and withdraw him from a course of ascetic austerity practised in those regions.
E.
हिम cold, or frost and snow, and आस्नय abode.

f. (-ती)
A sort of moon-plant; also स्वर्णक्षीर.

m. (-ह्वः)
Camphor.
E.
हिम snow, आह्व appellation.

m. (-यः)
Camphor.
n. (-यं)
A lotus.
E.
हिम cold, आह्वय appellation.

f. (-का)
Hoar frost.
E.
हिम frost, कन् aff., fem. form.

mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु)
Suffering from cold, chilly, frozen.
E.
हिम cold, एलु aff.

mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं)
Frozen, snowy, cold, frigid.
E.
हिम frost and snow, and यत् aff.
